# Update Handlers

Handlers wrap callback functions and define which Telegram update types they receive. Use a handler directly with Client.add_handler, or use a decorator for the same registration pattern.

## Example

```python
from pyrogram import Client
from pyrogram.handlers import MessageHandler

app = Client("my_account")

async def on_message(client, message):
    await message.reply("Hello")

app.add_handler(MessageHandler(on_message))
```
